Employee master list — the HR employee console's default view.

Requests pre-approved overtime with employee consent (LPA s.24). Either the employee requests their own, or a manager requests on a named employee's behalf (same route, same permission — see ot.controller.ts).

Views the holiday calendar for a given year, including auto-generated substitutes.
